headline.en: A broader map from score to editable production
headline.zh: 从乐谱到可编辑制作的完整链路

summary.en: This historical expansion adds 35 papers and 22 public implementations. It follows the production chain from score-aware expressive performance and instrument rendering, through editable synthesizer programs and sound matching, to multitrack arrangement and DAW-integrated tools. Project pages and source repositories are kept distinct so readers can see what is actually reusable.
summary.zh: 本次历史扩展新增 35 篇论文和 22 个公开实现，沿着乐谱驱动的表现力演奏与乐器渲染、可编辑合成器程序与音色匹配，一直整理到多轨编排和 DAW 集成工具。页面同时区分项目演示与真实源码，方便读者判断哪些内容可以直接复用。

note.en: VirtuosoNet is an influential early reference for turning structured scores into expressive, editable piano performances.
note.zh: VirtuosoNet 是从结构化乐谱生成具有表现力且可编辑钢琴演奏的重要早期代表。

note.en: DDSynth-RL recovers editable synthesizer presets from target audio and publishes both code and model checkpoints.
note.zh: DDSynth-RL 从目标音频恢复可编辑合成器预设，并同时公开代码和模型权重。

note.en: TOMI organizes clips, sections, tracks, and transformations into full songs that can be rendered and edited inside REAPER.
note.zh: TOMI 将片段、段落、轨道和变换组织成完整歌曲，并可在 REAPER 中继续渲染和编辑。
